content.content:
---
callisto-cli: patch
---

**Release lookups no longer fail on pretty-printed forge responses.** A forge reply whose body contains a blank line, such as indented JSON, is now read whole instead of being cut at the last blank line.

- Why it matters: the truncated body failed to parse, so the lookup errored instead of reporting the real state.
- Adopt: nothing to do, upgrade.
(eval):1: no matches found: --include=*.md
37:| R3 | Values lose structure at boundaries: refs, YAML scalars, HTTP framing, input origin travel as `&str` | F04 `last_ref_segment` takes the last `/` (`init.rs:734`, two callers); F05 seven raw `replace()` into YAML (`init.rs:902-909`), `__COMMIT__` never parsed as `CommitSha`; F06 `rsplit_once("\r\n\r\n")` truncates a body with a blank line (`http.rs:56`; fails loudly); F10 every JSON parse error is E281/usage and paths ignore `--cwd` (`io.rs:19`); `checkpoint.rs` trailer search, `ls-tree` without `-z` | `BranchName` (only `from_full_ref` or `git check-ref-format --branch`); one `WorkflowScalar` encoder that `render_workflow` requires by type; header-first HTTP parse; `enum JsonInput { Stdin, Inline, File(PathBuf) }` through `resolve_file_arg` |
76:| Recovery and integrity defects found since | E (F01), F1/F2 (F02, F03), B (F06) |
94:- F06 is lower than the audit's medium: it fails loudly, only with pretty-printed bodies.
106:| B | F06 HTTP parser | `provider/http.rs` | yes | Sonnet, medium |
